Thorne possesses light, curly hair, which has been described as exquisite. Her eyes are also noted for being particularly captivating.

## History

Miss Thorne served as a new schoolteacher who guided [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) upon her return to school, inspiring her academic efforts and planning a school concert. Recognizing Nell's potential, Miss Thorne offered to include her in a special class designed to prepare students for the Regent's entrance exam. As rumors circulated that she might leave for a job in her home district's grade school, Miss Thorne reassured her class at the end of the term that she would return the following year. She continued to guide [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) through her autumn studies as [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) worked hard to prepare for the upcoming examination.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Thorne and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. ## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--thorne.md)

Miss Thorne serves as [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) Harcourt's teacher and mentor, taking her under her guidance when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to school. Recognizing Nell's academic potential, Miss Thorne includes her in a special class to prepare for the Regent's entrance exam to train as a teacher, and later reassures the class that she will return for the following school year. Under Miss Thorne's continued instruction, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) works hard through the autumn term to prepare for her upcoming examination.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Thorne and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV.
